name: Alex Rivera
headline: Senior Data Engineer | Cloud Data Platforms | Streaming and Batch Pipelines
summary: Data engineer with **6 years** building batch and streaming pipelines on **AWS**. Runs **Spark** and **dbt** transformations into **Snowflake**, orchestrated with **Airflow**, and owns the **data quality** checks that keep finance and operations reporting trustworthy. Moved a nightly reporting stack to near-real-time **Kafka** ingestion and cut warehouse spend by **31%** through model and clustering redesign.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
bullets: Re-platformed shipment event ingestion from nightly files to **Kafka** streams landing in **Snowflake**, cutting dashboard freshness from **24 hours to 6 minutes** for 300+ operations users.
Designed a layered **dbt** project (staging, intermediate, marts) with **data quality** tests on 140 models; failed-load incidents fell from roughly **9 a month to 2**.
Rebuilt the cost model with clustering keys and incremental materializations, reducing **Snowflake** spend by **31%** in two quarters.
Codified warehouse, **S3** and **Glue** resources in **Terraform** modules with **GitHub Actions** plans on every pull request.
Mentor two engineers through code review and pairing; lead the team's **Agile** sprint planning for the data platform backlog.

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built **PySpark** jobs on **AWS** EMR processing **2.5 TB** of claims data a day, written as **Delta Lake** tables with schema enforcement.
Orchestrated 60+ pipelines in **Airflow** with retries, SLAs and alerting; on-time delivery of daily feeds rose from **91% to 99.4%**.
Owned **data modeling** for member, claim and provider facts: a dimensional schema used by finance, actuarial and compliance teams.
Containerized ingestion utilities with **Docker** and added **CI/CD** checks that run unit tests and **SQL** linting before deploy.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Automated weekly sales reporting with **Python** and **SQL**, replacing a 6-hour manual spreadsheet process.
Wrote **Bash** and **Scala** utilities to reconcile point-of-sale exports against the inventory system.
